notes: Gathers in Shenzhen: the start point is the first place of 出發交通資料, 深圳羅湖口岸(地面)門前廣場(EGL旗號集合), without its bracketed notes; the end point is the last place of 回程交通資料, 深圳灣口岸 及 羅湖口岸 (解散), without (解散).
